blocks.text: The Anti-Money Laundering Council’s (AMLC) testimony — which found no link between the P560-million inflows to Leyte Rep. Martin Romualdez and flood control projects — does not weaken the case against him, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said on Friday.
